output.letter:
Anthropic's Staff ML Engineer role aligns closely with my current tech leadership and engineering work in production agent products, particularly in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and evaluation harnesses. At Sierra AI, I am the tech lead for a customer-support agent where I designed the structured-output enforcement and a CI-driven evaluation harness that improved verified-resolution rates from 41% to 67% and runs deterministically on all model-updates.

My experience building RAG systems includes owning the embedding-search service at Scale AI, serving 200M queries per month with 18ms p95 latency, and migrating production retrieval pipelines to hybrid dense+sparse setups that increased recall by 12pp. Additionally, I developed a post-training data pipeline that mines and routes failed agent traces for human rating, reducing rater cost by over 3x—directly paralleling the data curation partnership described for this role.

Beyond engineering, I mentor and grow teams; I currently mentor 3 engineers and lead a biweekly reading group focused on agents. I have two first-author papers in EMNLP and NAACL on retrieval-augmented generation, demonstrating comfort engaging with recent research papers in this area.

I aim to contribute my end-to-end LLM product expertise to Anthropic’s enterprise agent stack while deepening my knowledge of tool-use safety and refusal mechanisms within your innovative environment. Located in San Francisco, I am excited by the prospect of collaborating closely onsite.

Best,
Priya
output.meta_summary: Led with leadership in agent product RAG and eval systems at Sierra AI; mirrored Anthropic's emphasis on retrieval, eval harnesses, post-training data curation, and mentoring; highlighted match on first-author papers and production LLM shipping.

output.what_they_do: Anthropic builds enterprise customer-facing agent products involving retrieval, tool-calling, and evaluation stacks. signals_from_jd: Mentions owning the retrieval, tool-calling, and eval stack for agent products → end-to-end ownership in production systems, focusing on applied machine learning engineering.
Requires building CI evaluation harnesses running on every model PR → strong emphasis on continuous integration and automated model evaluation.
Specifies partnering with researchers on post-training data curation → close collaboration between engineering and research teams, indicating interdisciplinary workflows.
Mentions mentoring 3-5 individual contributors → expects leadership and team mentorship responsibilities.
Strong preference for local candidates with hybrid work (3 days/week) → company culture values in-person collaboration with some remote flexibility.
questions_to_ask: How is the RAG layer architected currently, and what are the main challenges anticipated in chunking, embedding, or reranking?
